name: Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen
summary: At Foothold Citadel, Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen directs Theramore’s medical care. He trains healers and tests seasoned medics in field triage and bandage work.

sections.title: Chief Physician of Theramore
sections.body: On Foothold Citadel’s ground floor, Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen tends the forces of Lady Jaina Proudmoore and trains Theramore’s frontline healers. Dustwallow Marsh makes their work harsh, so VanHowzen demands skill under pressure. Experienced medics face his demanding triage test and must judge which wounds need care first.

faq.q: Where can Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen be found?
faq.answer: Doctor VanHowzen works on the ground floor of Foothold Citadel, the main fortress on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: What role does VanHowzen serve for the Alliance?
faq.answer: Doctor VanHowzen leads Alliance Trauma as its chief physician and Theramore’s leading trauma surgeon. He oversees the garrison’s medical ward and trains seasoned Alliance field medics in Artisan First Aid.

faq.q: What does Doctor VanHowzen teach players?
aliases: what can i learn from vanhowzen
faq.answer: Doctor VanHowzen gives the Artisan First Aid triage assessment, which lets skilled medics raise their skill cap. He also teaches qualified practitioners to make Heavy Mageweave and Runecloth bandages.

faq.q: Does the Horde have a counterpart to Doctor VanHowzen?
aliases: who is horde first aid master
faq.answer: Yes. Doctor Gregory Victor is the Horde’s trauma specialist. He trains field medics and conducts triage examinations at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.

angles.text: As an Alliance medic, travel to Theramore and prove your triage skills under Doctor VanHowzen’s watchful eye to master field surgery.
